In the Atlantic, I traversed the whole breadth, from continent to continent. In the Pacific, I visited New Holland and New Zealand. In the Indian seas, I saw the East Indies, and China. In the whole, I beheld fifteen hundred objects of curiosity, and came home in safety.

name: Railway passenger at six miles an hour
text: I am a passenger on the railway, and I am allowed to travel at the rate of six miles an hour. The fare is divided into three parts; one part goes to the person who carries me, another part goes to the person who carries the former part, and the third part goes to me. If I am willing to carry the whole fare myself, I may do it; but if I choose to divide the whole fare among us, I may do that also. The characters of Eliminators are, teeth carnivorous, and tongue not rough; feet plantigrade; and body generally long. The species are few, and are confined to the eastern hemisphere. The genus Eliminator has been subdivided into Mustelidæ and Ursidæ. In the former, the species feed on animal food exclusively, and in the latter partly on vegetables. The Mustelidæ have a long and slender neck, and a sharp muzzle; the Ursidæ have a short and thick neck, and a muzzel rounded at the extremity. The species are all inhabitants of forests.
